test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five friends P, Q, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Q is second to the left of T. S is the immediate neighbour of Q and T. R is not the immediate neighbour of Q. While counting from the left of Q, how many friends are sitting between Q and S?
solution:
Given: Five friends P, Q, R, S and T. 

1) Q is second to the left of T. 

2) S is the immediate neighbour of Q and T. 

3) R is not the immediate neighbour of Q. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f87e3a4b985a7c802d00aa349c4224e5d68d3de5a4203cae233ad20ff21fc8cf.png] 

And, P will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b87546972a46da912196029e360d9b308678b83b22980251b7d2ceb517238e6.png] 

While counting from the left of Q, there are **three **friends are sitting between Q and S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
